As demo.quality it returns9 rows (doctors, Head Nurse, directors/owner, IPC and Quality), but neither Nurse Hina user18 nor Ops Admin user27. GET /staff/lookup?q=Hina returns Hina with user_id18. Fresh synthetic complaint2 is currently assigned to Ops27 and detail200 confirms that assignment. The actual UI lists every returned people row without filtering can_review; Hina is missing from the server list, not hidden locally. The documented picker therefore cannot select some staff whom the assignment workflow/API supports.

Please either document GET /staff/lookup -> user_id for these acknowledgement fields (it is already among Screen170's endpoints), or provide the complete eligible assignee directory. No assignment API defect or staff-lookup defect is alleged; I have not added typed ids, broadened permissions, or guessed a fallback policy.
